request.questionText: Which of the following statements is accurate with respect to the normal distribution? (1) The normal distribution is characterized with two parameters: the mean and the standard deviation. (2) The normal distribution is characterized with two parameters: the median and the IQR. (3) Approximately 95% of the observations in a normal distribution will take on a value within plus or minus two standard deviations of the mean.
